name: Valley Garden Center
notes: Own site (https://valleygardencenterphx.org/) describes a nonprofit garden and wedding/event venue at 1809 N 15th Ave, not a retail store; Yelp lists it as Venues & Event Spaces (https://www.yelp.com/biz/valley-garden-center-phoenix). It is about 1.9 mi from downtown Phoenix, so 1.7 is plausible.

name: The Golf Mart
notes: The store page returned little beyond its title. Listings confirm a golf equipment/apparel/club-fitting store at 470-A Noor Ave (https://www.yelp.com/biz/the-golf-mart-south-san-francisco-3, https://www.pga.com/play/ca/south-san-francisco/the-golf-mart-south-san-francisco-worldwide-golf-shops/27442383). A site search of worldwidegolfshops.com found no headlamps or flashlights.

name: Great Wall Supermarket
notes: The own-site page rendered only a header (JS-driven). Listings confirm an Asian supermarket at 2200 W Alameda Ave (https://www.yelp.com/biz/great-wall-supermarket-denver-2, https://westdenvermarketplaces.com/businesses/great-wall-supermarket/). Reviews mention a houseware/cookware section, but I found no evidence of insulated bottles specifically.

name: Trader Joe's
notes: The store page confirms 661 Logan St, Denver, with no drinkware mentioned. The traderjoes.com product search returned 403, and web search found no confirmed TJ-sold reusable insulated bottles (only unverified mentions of limited items).

name: Hobby Lobby
notes: The store page confirms Store 37, Austin Southpark Meadows, 9600 S IH-35 Ste L. Site searches for 'pour over' and 'coffee dripper' found no drippers, but the small kitchen appliances category lists a French Press ($10.99) and a stainless kettle (https://hobbylobby.com/home-decor-frames/kitchen-dinnerware/kitchen-appliances/c/3-119-1001). In-store stock was not confirmed.

name: Outdoor Cover Warehouse
notes: The URL failed with a redirect loop. Search shows the company sells boat, RV, car and patio covers, not apparel (https://www.outdoorcoverwarehouse.com/), with a listing in Dayton OH (https://about.me/outdoorcover.warehouse). 234 Monsignor O'Brien Hwy is Cambridge Sound and Security (https://www.cambridgesoundandsecurity.com/), and '#446' looks like a service-area landing page address. The address is about 1.5 mi from central Cambridge, not 3.

name: Apple Lincoln Park
notes: The store page confirms 801 W North Ave with current hours. An apple.com search for 'battery' shows only power banks, MagSafe batteries and device chargers, with no AA batteries (https://www.apple.com/us/search/battery). The address is about 2.4 mi from the Loop, not 0.7.

name: Ford General
notes: Own site shows a menswear/apparel boutique (clothing, footwear, accessories, apothecary) at 1712 N Wells St, with no batteries or electronics. The address is about 2.4 mi from the Loop, not 0.9.

name: Verizon
notes: The site is The Mobile Generation, a Verizon authorized retailer selling phones and plans. Verizon's batteries category lists power banks and device-specific batteries, with no AA batteries (https://www.verizon.com/products/batteries/). 3019 N Clark St is confirmed by Verizon's locator (https://www.verizon.com/business/locations/il/chicago/3019-n-clark-st-a00000327796/) and Yelp. It is about 4 mi from the Loop, not 1.2.

name: Needleworks USA
notes: Own site is a custom embroidery service (patches, monogramming, embroidery on blankets) that names a 'Denver warehouse' and no storefront, and it sells no wool blankets. Yelp/YP list 9511 Bighorn Way (https://www.yelp.com/biz/the-needle-works-littleton), which is in the Roxborough Village single-family subdivision (https://www.redfin.com/CO/Littleton/9651-Bighorn-Way-80125/home/35270059). That makes it a residential address, about 9 mi from downtown Littleton, not 5.8.

name: Tattered Cover Aspen Grove
notes: Own site lists the Aspen Grove store at 7301 S Santa Fe Dr, Littleton. It sells a 'Colorful Book Throw Blanket' ($34.99), shown as in stock at Aspen Grove, but the material is not stated, so it is not confirmed wool (https://www.tatteredcover.com/products/0059283881509). The address is about 2 mi from downtown Littleton.

name: Outdoor Cover Warehouse
notes: The URL failed with a redirect loop. The company sells boat, RV, car and patio covers, not apparel (https://www.outdoorcoverwarehouse.com/). 5900 Mallory Rd is a 1965 single-family house listed for sale (https://www.zillow.com/homedetails/5900-Mallory-Rd-Atlanta-GA-30349/35956753_zpid/), and the '#30349' suite is just the ZIP code. ZIP 30349 includes Red Oak, so ~2 mi is plausible.
